what_is_plotted: panel 1: the Part A found-arc table (best found here, doc 50 SSC2 as published, the proved maximum 2M-2 and the Davenport-Schinzel bound 2M-1) for every M in the table. panel 2: the Part B per-twin M-ary ceilings for all four doc 47 SS13 categories at M in {2,4,8,12}, the doc 50 SSC3 published value of each cell, the doc 47 SS13 pair-level binary anchor, and the one K=2 cross-term.

encoding.panel1_x: readout arity M, evenly spaced categorical positions
encoding.panel1_y: decision arcs carved on the circle at K=1 (integer count)
encoding.panel1_bars: filled = recomputed here; hollow with ink edge = doc 50 SSC2
encoding.panel1_rules: solid mid-ink = achievable maximum 2M-2; dashed muted = DS 2M-1
encoding.panel2_x: readout arity M in {2,4,8,12} on EVENLY SPACED categorical positions -- arity steps are a design choice, not a measured interval, so a linear numeric axis would invent a slope
encoding.colour: categorical, one slot per doc 47 SS13 category, in the same four validated slots and the same order as fig_capacity_validation, so the two figures read as one system
encoding.secondary_encoding: filled marker + solid line = recomputed here; hollow marker, no line = doc 50 SSC3 as published; tick = doc 47 SS13 pair-level binary anchor; diamond = K=2 cross-term. Source is therefore never carried by colour alone.
